resources.string: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF. Text is read on this phone; nothing is uploaded.
Tries every built-in language on the first page and keeps the best match. Pick a language yourself if a page mixes scripts.
English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, Malay, Swahili and other languages written in Latin letters.
Hindi, Marathi, Nepali and Sanskrit, written in Devanagari. English words on the page are read too.
Simplified and Traditional Chinese, with English words on the page.
Japanese kanji, hiragana and katakana, with English words on the page.
Korean Hangul, with English words on the page.
All language models are built into the app, so recognition works offline and never needs a download.
